### Planning Intelligence Log — Architecture-vs-Evidence Remediation (2026-05-16 audit)

- audit_source: docs/findings/architecture-vs-evidence-audit-2026-05-16.md
- audit_record: flagged_probes = [1, 2, 3, 5, 6], severity = high
- session_outcome:
    confirmed_probes:
      - probe_1: SC11 (self-use) added — dogfooding loop verified at sprint Phase I
      - probe_2: Operational Constraints / Workflow Trigger Filter Enumeration section added
      - probe_3: Operational Constraints / State Lifecycle Owner Block section added (10 state vars + telemetry storage anchored to GHA artifacts)
    deferred_probes:
      - probe_5: skipped — epic has zero children; story breakdown belongs to sprint's preplanning phase per project convention
      - probe_6: skipped — audit's suggested External Dependencies block would gate closure on external state (4-week wall-clock, real consuming-project installs), violating the project's in-session-verifiability rule; SC9(a)-(j) fixtures already provide in-session verification of the underlying capability
- verification:
    method: per-probe sub-agent re-check against revised description (sonnet)
    result: pass (3/3 confirmed probes returned NO_FLAG with specific section citations)
- next_step: none (remediation-partial — probe 5 ignored by project rule, probe 6 deferred by user rule)
